'''Jorm''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] naval [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] who served in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
The captain was the commanding officer of the [[Tanker/Legends|fuel tanker]] [[Aurora (fuel tanker)/Legends|''Aurora'']]. During the war, his ship was attacked by several [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] in a mock attack meant to lure out the [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] ''[[Starcrusher/Legends|Starcrusher]]''.

The vessel was then infiltrated by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] strike team which prompted the battleship to send a shuttle of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] to clear them out. The droids completely ignored Jorm and brushed past him as they arrived. The droids were then dismantled in secret by the Jedi and used as disguises to enter the ''Starcrusher''. The nervous tanker captain saw the droids off and returned to his post, ordering the ''Aurora'' to leave the system.
